thread:
Leo (CSM): Quick post-dry-run note for Greenhaven: overall green but three small items blocking final cutover - egress CIDR narrower, KMS key policy needs infra principal, and audit prefixes inconsistent with customer SIEM. low severity but want fixes before handoff.

Olga (Greenhaven): thanks — infra used 198.18.0.0/25 instead of the /24 we were given. they only had that allocation pre-approved.

Anya (Solutions): we can accept the extra /25 to cover the remainder temporarily, but recommend they add the full /24 when feasible. Request them to add 198.18.0.128/25 as well.

Marcus (Eng-Infra): SG egress we expect (AWS):
```
Type: All TCP
Protocol: TCP
Port range: 0-65535
Destination: 198.18.0.0/24
Description: Redwood egress (api.redwood.internal)
```
If they only keep /25 some control-plane calls may be rate-limited.

Olga (Greenhaven): i'll ask infra to add the second /25, should be quick.

Priya (SRE): audit forwarder is tagging streams as `gh-prod` and `gh-debug`. Their SIEM rules only match `gh-prod`. recommend we normalize prefixes to `gh-prod` during cutover.

Leo (CSM): Marcus — can you share the minimal KMS policy addition we need? client wants rotation Friday but our MR is Sat.

Marcus (Eng-Infra): minimal snippet to add to customer key policy (paste and save):
{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-infra"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}]}
This grants our infra role enough to rotate and avoid failure windows.

Olga (Greenhaven): pasted and saved. rotation stays Fri 02:00 local.

Anya (Solutions): retention check — compliance requires 90d. pipeline default was 30d. i'll coordinate storage adjustment.

Priya (SRE): opened CI-9012 to extend retention to 90d and temporary 14-day snapshot until change deploys.

audit-bot: Dry-run report uploaded: https://deploys.redwood.internal/reports/6832104567  artifacts: net-check.tgz, kms-snippet.json, audit-preview.log

Leo (CSM): action list: Marcus - verify SG change and run smoke; Anya - confirm retention ETA; Priya - normalize prefixes & close CI-9012; Olga - confirm second /25 applied and rotation time. please update by EOD tomorrow. i'll mark a medium renewal watch if cutover slips >10 days.

Olga (Greenhaven): second /25 requested, infra ETA ~2h. will post smoke result.

Marcus (Eng-Infra): will run smoke when they push, ETA 90m.

Anya (Solutions): retention timeline by EOD.

Priya (SRE): will update CI-9012 when SIEM sees normalized prefix.

Leo (CSM): thanks team — closing after confirmations.
